description.ko: 하나의 컴파일러 바이너리로 통합 검사가 끝난 시점을 보존한다. 이후 작업 트리 변경의 검증을 뜻하지 않는다.
description.en: Preserve one coherent compiler/test checkpoint without certifying later working-tree changes.

binary.execution_scope: Local host execution; not proof of every target platform.

source_snapshot.working_tree: Includes uncommitted development changes. Git HEAD alone is not the tested source snapshot.
source_snapshot.identity_boundary: All306 recorded compiler/runtime/library/test/tool files and the compiler hash stayed unchanged across both CTest segments. The initial invocation completed128 passing tests before interruption; CTest resume completed only the remaining Ordered test. This records one frozen snapshot, not one uninterrupted invocation or later working-tree changes.

ctest.note: The immutable logs contain129 distinct passing test names. The initial invocation was interrupted before an elapsed-time summary; no combined wall-time figure is invented. Later invocations may replace the ordinary temporary CTest logs.

task_owned.scope: Owned-only captures/results, one native thread per admitted child, retained Scope observation loans and explicit/retrying drain. Eight added observations/cancellation/scope-admission operations are part of this snapshot. Borrowed workers, nested scopes, pools, composition, detach and remaining synchronous catalog APIs are not implemented by this subset.

task_resources.scope: File ownership/worker IO/Drop plus monotonic time and blocking sleep. This is not async suspension.

thread_safety.scope: Sealed derived Send/Sync, transitive effects and cleanup, narrow audited IO admission.

bytes.scope: Prior endian/bit/copy helpers plus fallible owning buffers and strict UTF8 adapters; named Byte scalar argument controls preserve historical0.2 introduction. Source buffer operations validate full extents/reserve before mutation; UTF8 decoder documents revalidation and copying.

float_bits.scope: Exact f16/bf16/f32/f64 raw representation and closed numeric-conversion verifier, not future floating source utilities.

range.scope: Seven descriptor inspection operations and preserved source bounds after iteration.

selected_gates.ordered: The remaining registered Ordered gate passed in274.21seconds after CTest resume on the unchanged snapshot; complete catalog iterator coverage remains separate.

task_scope.scope: Admission close, active count including prepared work, Open/Closing status, nonowning ScopeError.Failure and prepared-before-close commit. Failure injection verifies retained owners; no Drained owner state is fabricated.

floating.scope: Exact classification/sign/magnitude/next/total-order/format constants over f16,bf16,f32,f64; existing f32/f64 signum preserves signed zero and NaN. Shared canonical FloatClass reexports and imported generic constant inference are exercised.

char_scalar.scope: Char.from_u32/to_u32 validate before char construction; invalid payload retained exactly. CoreError.Char bridges to the Error interface.

unicode.scope: Explicit imported scalar/ASCII/code-unit/escape helpers; UTF8/UTF16 Python oracle, precise malformed/incomplete offsets, transactional bounded writes, owned/dynamic errors and VT-excluding Char ASCII whitespace contract. No UCD property/name/case/segmentation implementation is certified.

browser_check.cleanup: English restored; temporary tab and localhost server closed.
browser_check.boundary: Historical layout/language-switch evidence predates this checkpoint render. The new checkpoint label and later lifecycle rows have not received a new browser verification.

excluded_future_work: The full synchronous CPU catalog remains incomplete; passing gates and declaration counts do not establish every documented signature.
Borrowed Task captures/results, scoped provenance expansion, nested/local/pool executors, groups/composition/detach remain outside the owned-worker profile.
Unicode property/case/name data and source integer/Boolean preview batches are outside this snapshot.
The subsequent FnOnce environment-consume compiler patch is not certified by this checkpoint.
GPU-only operations remain deferred; suspending Task/async APIs target0.4.
This local macOS ARM64 snapshot does not establish latest-source Linux or Windows execution.
Performance-changing optimization stays held until final Claude advice.
